description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/custom-lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildCustomMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSets" name="Give sets to children"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers (children)"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponent" name="Build and test one subcomponent">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subcomponent" name="Start subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckContainer" name="Check container for parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContainerParts" name="Parts remain in container?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Continue building"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent from sorted parts"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Subcomponent" name="Subcomponent test successful"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subcomponent" targetRef="Task_CheckContainer"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ContainerGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckContainer" targetRef="Gateway_ContainerParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Container_HasParts" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContainerParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Parts remain in container</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Container_Empty" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContainerParts" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No parts remain in container</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_BuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_ResultGateway" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Success" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_Subcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Subcomponent test is successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Failure" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Subcomponent test is not successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesign_BuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleMachine" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Machine assembled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Order" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Give" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Give_Sort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sort_BuildTest" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildTest_Assemble" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildTestSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_AssembleMachine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleMachine" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
